parts:
So this is me probably just not understanding the code.

I have a dataset which looks like:

I am building an association model using:

# Load dataset from ODBC database table.
basket0 <- new.env()
basket0$odbc <- odbcConnect("gclust3rSFRAnalytics2", believeNRows=TRUE)
basket0$dataset <- sqlQuery(basket0$odbc, query_basket_0)

set.seed(crv$seed) 
basket0$nobs <- nrow(basket0$dataset)  
basket0$sample <- basket0$train <- sample(nrow(basket0$dataset), 0.7*basket0$nobs) 
basket0$validate <- sample(setdiff(seq_len(nrow(basket0$dataset)), basket0$train), 0.15*basket0$nobs) 
basket0$test <- setdiff(setdiff(seq_len(nrow(basket0$dataset)), basket0$train), basket0$validate)

# The following variable selections have been noted.

basket0$input <- NULL
basket0$numeric <- NULL
basket0$categoric <- NULL
basket0$target  <- "gameName"
basket0$risk    <- NULL
basket0$ident   <- "ETLSessionId"
basket0$ignore  <- NULL
basket0$weights <- NULL

# The 'arules' package provides the 'arules' function.

require(arules, quietly=TRUE)

# Generate a transactions dataset.

basket0$transactions <- as(split(basket0$dataset[basket0$sample, basket0$target],
                             basket0$dataset[basket0$sample, basket0$ident]),
                       "transactions")

basket0$transactions

# build a model

basket0Apriori <- new.env(parent=basket0)
evalq({
  model <- apriori(basket0$transactions,parameter=list(support=0.01, confidence=0.01, minlen=2))
}, basket0Apriori)
inspect(sort(basket0Apriori$model, by="confidence"))

What I get back is results which look like:

lhs rhs support confidence lift 1 {145} => {147} 0.01202 0.11054 0.8041 2 {129} => {147} 0.01183 0.10311 0.7501 3 {147} => {145} 0.01202 0.08743 0.8041 4 {147} => {129} 0.01183 0.08607 0.7501

My question:
why are my {LHS} and {RHS} identifiers apparently hashed, and what do I need to do to get the Title information to display instead?
I have looked in the docs for apriori and for rattle(), and can see no solution.
note this code is running in RStudio, but the code is directly based on the Rattle() log and the issue also occurs in Rattle() as well when I run the model there.
Is there a box I am not checking?
